task:
Sale prices are rounded per unit, which makes multi-quantity lines wrong by a cent. The rounding lives in the
helper shop.money.round_line(price, qty); fix it there. In shop/cart.py a line on sale must be computed as
round2(unit_price * (100 - SALE_PERCENT) / 100 * qty): rounded once on the line total, not per unit. Example:
unit price 0.99, qty 3, on sale (20% off) is 2.38, not 2.37. Lines not on sale are plain round2(unit_price * qty).
Keep shop.pricing.sale_price(unit_price) unchanged for single units. Add unit tests.

units.title: Round sale lines once on the line total in Cart.line_total
units.spec: The task names a helper shop.money.round_line(price, qty), but it does not exist. shop/money.py only defines round2 and fmt. The per-unit rounding actually happens in shop/cart.py, in Cart.line_total, which calls sale_price(unit_price) (already rounded) and then multiplies by qty. Fix it there and do not create round_line. In shop/cart.py, change the import to `from shop.pricing import SALE_PERCENT, apply_coupon` and drop the now-unused sale_price import. Rewrite Cart.line_total(item) so that: (1) when self.on_sale is true it returns round2(item["unit_price"] * (100 - SALE_PERCENT) / 100 * item["qty"]); (2) otherwise it returns round2(item["unit_price"] * item["qty"]). Keep the signature unchanged and keep subtotal and total unchanged. Leave shop/pricing.py and shop/money.py untouched.
acceptance: Cart(on_sale=True) with add('x', 0.99, 3) gives line_total == 2.38 and subtotal() == 2.38
Existing tests in tests/test_cart.py and tests/test_pricing.py still pass

units.title: Unit tests for line-level sale rounding
units.spec: In tests/test_cart.py, add tests to CartTests using unittest. (a) test_sale_line_rounded_once: Cart(on_sale=True) with add('pen', 0.99, 3) gives subtotal() == 2.38 and line_total(cart.items[0]) == 2.38. (b) test_sale_single_unit_matches_sale_price: Cart(on_sale=True) with add('pen', 0.99, 1) gives subtotal() == sale_price(0.99) == 0.79. (c) test_non_sale_line: Cart() with add('pen', 0.99, 3) gives subtotal() == 2.97. (d) test_sale_multi_line_subtotal: Cart(on_sale=True) with add('a', 0.99, 3) and add('b', 10.00, 2) gives subtotal() == 18.38. Import sale_price from shop.pricing for test (b). Keep every existing test.
acceptance: All new tests pass after U1
test_sale_line_rounded_once would fail against the old per-unit implementation (it would give 2.37)

rules.text: Standard library only; use unittest, and run tests with `python -m unittest discover -s tests -t .`.
Round exactly once per line with shop.money.round2; never multiply an already-rounded unit price by qty.
shop.pricing.sale_price keeps its signature and behavior for single units.
Keep functions small and add no module-level mutable state.

dont_list: Don't invent shop.money.round_line or any new helper in money.py; the helper named in the task does not exist, so fix Cart.line_total
Don't modify sale_price, apply_coupon, round2, or SALE_PERCENT
Don't call sale_price() inside line_total for sale lines; that reintroduces per-unit rounding
Don't leave an unused sale_price import in shop/cart.py
Don't use Decimal or change the float money representation
Don't delete or weaken existing tests
